ruleActionPayloadSemanticDispatch.note: Partial action types decode their complete bounded envelopes but retain nested folder/message EntryID semantic fields as raw nodes with warnings.

restrictionSemanticDispatch.note: Includes SubObjectRestriction, which exists upstream but is omitted from its central dispatcher.

remainingSemanticAreas: Remaining 78 request and 79 response individual ROP dispatcher cases
Nested EntryID semantic fields for OP_MOVE, OP_COPY, OP_REPLY, and OP_OOF_REPLY rule actions
FastTransfer and ICS lexical/syntactical grammars and partial-stream reconstruction
Capture-local logon, table-column, notification, and handle correlation beyond framing
safetyDivergences: Unknown operations, properties, restrictions, and auxiliary blocks are retained as bounded offset/length raw nodes with warnings.
Malformed XOR/compression/framing is transactional and never exposed as successful decoded data.
Extended-rule EntryID sizes and recipient/property counts use the 32-bit widths required by MS-OXORULE rather than the pinned upstream parser's narrower reads.
All declared lengths, counts, strings, allocations, recursion, nodes, and payloads are explicitly bounded.
Parser state is per capture rather than upstream static global state.

Auxiliary offset-referenced trailer fields (e.g. MachineName/UserName/ServerDN/ProcessName/annotation strings) are resolved via bounds-checked random-access reads from validated offsets rather than upstream's unchecked sequential pointer arithmetic; out-of-range offsets warn and omit the field, while zero offsets represent absent fields and are omitted without warning.

AUX_EXCEPTION_TRACE is decoded into an "ExceptionMessage" array of individual ExceptionMessage[0..N] line fields split on CR/LF from the bounded remainder after the fixed RopIndex header, rather than upstream's raw single-string dump; this is a readability enhancement and does not change the underlying bytes considered or bounds enforced.
